Whether quantity is one step or the total is Unknown (Q-JET-A3): read the cart back with cartView. The id is the shop-product id (extras.itemId), not product_id. Live HAR 2026-10-30: Jet's website sends only {shop_product_id, source:"web", add_cart_source} (no quantity, no lat/lng) and each add left that line at quantity 1; quantity, source_page and lat/lng here are SuperYar additions Jet may ignore.
